rubric: All explicitly requested aspects in prose. For M0 factual claims are checked against full pinned PDFs; absence of citations is not hallucination. For RAG completeness, sent evidence, and semantic quote entailment required; literal provenance checked separately. Wrong includes false refusal on answerable question or answering none of requested aspects. Partial not correct; appropriate no-data refusal correct. No LLM calls, secrets or source/config changes.

implementation_findings.note: Coverage review is model judgement, not semantic proof: D01/D03 false-positive complete=true despite missing explicit question aspects. Revision is bounded and validated structurally only; D02 revision remains incomplete, and no final semantic review is performed. coverage_review is a draft review, not evidence that the final revision was rejected.

D05–D08 appropriate refusals trigger additional revision because critic marks complete/supported false while describing refusal as justified. All calls are traced; this increases measured cost without improving facts.
